decisions.rationale: Engaged signals: onboarding call held [calendar:ddcac281], raised a ticket [tick_4f99136fffa3]. But 6 days in with no project, no invite, no key milestone, and an unresolved badge bug plus two unanswered follow-ups [email:448354a8, email:a1f317ae] suggest drift; 8 days left leaves some chance.

draft.subject: Your notification badge ticket + getting your first project going
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Thanks again for flagging the notification badge that won't clear — your ticket is still open and I'm tracking it, so you'll hear from me as soon as I have something concrete.

Separately, after our call last week I wanted to check in on setup. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything else while we're on.

Best,
Chidi
